'''SoapBox Films''' is the film database and audience-review surface of the [[SoapBox]] ecosystem, published at stream.soapbox.community/films. It works alongside [[SoapBox Stream]]: Stream is where free films play, and Films is where any film can be looked up, located and reviewed.

== What it holds ==
* A catalogue of notable films of every kind, built from Wikidata, with director, cast, genre, year and runtime.
* '''Where to watch''': links to the services a film is listed on (streaming, rental, free-with-ads), plus a general search link. Availability varies by region and changes over time, so these are listings, not guarantees.
* '''Audience reviews''': anyone can rate a film from half a star to five and write a review, with no account. Each film gets an audience score: the share of ratings at 3.5 stars or more, with the average and the number of reviews.

== Watch and review, both ways ==
When SoapBox Stream holds a free, public-domain copy of a film, the film's page offers '''Watch free on SoapBox Stream'''. From the Stream player, the film's score and a '''Rate & review''' link sit beside the video. The Stream's horror shelves, including A Map of Horror and the Girl Has to Kill Everyone genre, link every title into Films.

== Scope ==
Films is a separate system from this Library. Individual films are not Library articles; they live on SoapBox Films.
